Scoring Notes for Part B 

• 
To earn P3 and P4, the terms of the series can be presented in a list or as part of a polynomial or 
series. Extraneous terms are treated as scratch work and do not impact scoring of P3 and P4. 

• 
A response must earn P3 to be eligible for P4.
